title: Directors' resolution in writing
summary: The directors end the appointment of the secretary or the chief executive officer, and authorise the lodgement with ACRA. A director is removed by the members.

paragraphs: We, being all the directors of {{.Company.Name}}, pass the following resolutions in writing, as the company's constitution allows.

sections.heading: Resolved
items: That {{.F.officer_id}} cease to be the company's {{.F.officer_id_role}} with effect from {{.F.on}}.
That any one director or the secretary be authorised to lodge the cessation with ACRA.
